integrity: The proof is self-contained modulo the published definition, Lemma 2.4 on cover-order subadditivity, and the published finite-orbit formula used only for sharpness. No computational experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only finite-index subgroup restriction for Meyerovitch dynamical dimension.
The originality search cannot prove global uniqueness; two later relevant preprints were inspected only through their abstracts.
No classification of equality cases is claimed.
title: Sharp finite-index restriction law for dynamical dimension
